blocks.en: The in-line photometer tracks OD600 continuously without removing samples from the bioreactor.
blocks.text: The in-line photometer tracks OD600 continuously without removing samples from the bioreactor.
blocks.zh: 線上光度計不必從生物反應器取出樣品，就能連續追蹤 OD600。

blocks.en: Monitoring bacterial growth typically requires repeated sampling and expensive laboratory equipment, which can interrupt bioreactor operation and increase the risk of contamination. To address this, we developed an in-line photometer that continuously measures culture density (OD600) without removing samples. The device uses two light beams to improve measurement consistency and allows real-time monitoring of bacterial growth. Both the full and simplified versions were compared against a benchtop BioDrop to evaluate their accuracy and precision, helping refine our design for reliable, continuous bioreactor monitoring. To redefine assembly guides in the direction of global accessibility, we tested our photometer guides on beginners with no hardware background, telling us what and where we needed to rewrite.

blocks.zh: 監測細菌生長通常得反覆取樣，並仰賴昂貴的實驗室儀器，這會中斷生物反應器的運轉，也提高污染風險。為此我們開發了線上（in-line）光度計，不取出樣品就能連續量測培養液密度（OD600）。這套裝置以兩道光束提升量測的一致性，讓細菌生長得以即時監測。完整版與簡化版都與桌上型 BioDrop 比對，以評估兩者的準確度與精密度，協助我們把設計修到足以可靠地連續監測生物反應器。為了把組裝指南改寫得讓全球的人都用得上，我們請沒有硬體背景的初學者照著我們的光度計指南動手做，從中得知哪些地方需要重寫、該怎麼寫。

blocks.en: Why in line? The chassis, Bacillus subtilis, grows at ambient temperature, and a bioreactor on a farm cannot hold its temperature exactly. We need the culture’s density in real time to judge yield and health, and development needs growth curves at several temperatures to model growth. Sampling by hand for a benchtop spectrophotometer disturbs the culture and risks contaminating it, so the photometer reads OD600 inside the loop, with nothing drawn out. Three choices keep long runs honest: a beam splitter sends 10% of the light to a reference sensor that tracks LED drift; a short 2 mm flow cuvette behind a plano‑convex (paralleling) lens keeps a dense culture from saturating the reading; and a transistor switches the LED, so it can run at a higher voltage than the sensors to raise the upper limit (9.1).

blocks.zh: 為什麼要做線上量測？底盤菌 Bacillus subtilis 在環境溫度下生長，而放在農場的生物反應器無法把溫度控得很精準。我們需要即時知道培養液的密度，才能判斷產量與健康狀況；開發階段也需要多個溫度下的生長曲線來建立生長模型。為桌上型分光光度計手動取樣會擾動培養液，也有污染風險，因此這台光度計直接在迴路內讀取 OD600，不取出任何東西。三項選擇讓長時間運轉的數據站得住腳：分光鏡把 10% 的光送往參考感測器，用來追蹤 LED 的漂移；平凸（平行化）透鏡後方只有 2 mm 的短流通比色槽，使高密度培養液不會讓讀值飽和；LED 由電晶體切換，因此可以用比感測器更高的電壓驅動，把量測上限往上拉（9.1）。

blocks.en: We chose B. subtilis because it is practical to clone, grows well at ambient temperature and secretes proteins into its medium. Strain 168 also has weak motility and biofilm formation, which limits how long it could survive in soil. The bioreactor has two modules: a cultivation module that grows the bacteria and a hollow‑fiber membrane module that separates them from their protein product. This first cycle tested the two together at room temperature, with a serum bottle as the reservoir and a peristaltic pump circulating the broth.
blocks.text: We chose B. subtilis because it is practical to clone, grows well at ambient temperature and secretes proteins into its medium. Strain 168 also has weak motility and biofilm formation, which limits how long it could survive in soil. The bioreactor has two modules: a cultivation module that grows the bacteria and a hollow‑fiber membrane module that separates them from their protein product. blocks.zh: 我們選 B. subtilis，是因為它便於選殖、在環境溫度下生長良好，而且會把蛋白質分泌到培養基中。168 菌株的運動性與生物膜形成能力也弱，這限制了它在土壤中能存活多久。生物反應器有兩個模組：負責長菌的培養模組，以及把菌體與其蛋白質產物分開的中空纖維薄膜模組。第一個循環在室溫下把兩者接在一起測試，以血清瓶作為儲液瓶，用蠕動幫浦讓菌液循環。

blocks.en: The goal was a working continuous‑flow loop through a PES hollow‑fiber membrane, made of the membrane, a medium reservoir, a peristaltic pump and a Luer valve for sampling (the illustration).

blocks.zh: 目標是做出一條能運作的連續流迴路，穿過 PES 中空纖維薄膜，由薄膜、培養基儲液瓶、蠕動幫浦與一個取樣用的 Luer 閥組成（見示意圖）。

blocks.en: The PES membrane (lumen volume ~200 mL, surface area about 1.3 m²) was connected to a 500 mL reservoir holding 300 mL of LB, inoculated with 20 mL (1:15) of a multi‑overnight B. subtilis culture. A silicone tube joined the two shell‑side outlets to close the shell side. For each OD600 reading we drew broth by syringe from the Luer valve and measured it on a BioDrop spectrophotometer. The control was the same culture in a 500 mL conical flask at 37 °C and 200 rpm.

blocks.en: The gap between the tube’s and the reservoir’s final OD600 (0.304 against 0.48) suggests that, without mixing, sampling in line underestimated the culture. The lack of active mixing most likely let nutrients stratify and cells settle in the reservoir, which limited growth. We planned three changes for the next cycle: biocompatible (BPT) tubing to stop the leaks at the pump, an active magnetic stirrer like a lab hot‑plate stirrer to keep the reservoir even, and sampling ports moved to the reservoir’s outlet for more accurate readings and less contamination risk. Catching this early showed that mixing had to be solved before the long BPT run.

blocks.en: The main problem was the calibration procedure, not the optics. 4.1 設計理由

blocks.en: The Pro is costly. The beam splitter, paralleling lens and flow cuvette make up US$275 of its US$371.78 in parts (11.1). The flow cuvette is needed for in‑line measurement, so we looked for a way to drop the lens and the beam splitter while still reading OD600 reliably.
blocks.text: The Pro is costly. The beam splitter, paralleling lens and flow cuvette make up US$275 of its US$371.78 in parts (11.1). The flow cuvette is needed for in‑line measurement, so we looked for a way to drop the lens and the beam splitter while still reading OD600 reliably.
blocks.zh: Pro 的成本偏高。分光鏡、平行化透鏡與流通比色槽就占了零件費 US$371.78 中的 US$275（11.1）。流通比色槽是線上量測必需的，因此我們想辦法去掉透鏡與分光鏡，同時仍能可靠地讀出 OD600。
4.2 設計變更

blocks.en: Optical fibers route the light straight to the cuvette, so no paralleling lens is needed, and a fiber can be split into two paths of matching intensity, so no beam splitter is needed either. For simplicity the fibers are split 1:1 between the sample and reference sensors, instead of the Pro’s 9:1. The Slim is more than two‑thirds smaller than the Pro and costs US$136.49 less (11.1).

4.3 與 Pro 的比較

blocks.en: Both photometers track the BioDrop linearly. The Pro reads OD600 nearly 1:1 with the BioDrop, so its range is also about the BioDrop’s. The Slim is just as linear but reads about ⅕ as high (×5.57 to convert). It is less sensitive, but should read denser cultures before its sensor runs out of range (an estimate, 5.2.3). It is also cheaper (US$235.29 against US$371.78, 11.1) and has fewer parts to align and maintain.

blocks.en: We needed to check that the photometer’s readings match real values. Calibrating with culture brings growth, settling and cell lysis into the measurement, so particle suspensions served as a stable scattering target. The iGEM standard for OD600 calibration is SiO2, but TiO2 was already in the lab, behaves nearly the same suspended in 1% SDS and is much cheaper, so we ran a TiO2 curve first and an SiO2 curve after. The Slim was finished after the TiO2 test, so it was only in the SiO2 run.

Calibrating with culture brings growth, settling and cell lysis into the measurement, so particle suspensions served as a stable scattering target. The iGEM standard for OD600 calibration is SiO2, but TiO2 was already in the lab, behaves nearly the same suspended in 1% SDS and is much cheaper, so we ran a TiO2 curve first and an SiO2 curve after. The Slim was finished after the TiO2 test, so it was only in the SiO2 run.
blocks.zh: 我們需要確認光度計的讀值與真實值相符。用培養液校正會把生長、沉降與細胞破裂一起帶進量測，因此我們改用顆粒懸浮液當作穩定的散射標的。iGEM 校正 OD600 的標準品是 SiO2，但實驗室裡本來就有 TiO2，它懸浮在 1% SDS 中的行為幾乎相同，而且便宜得多，所以我們先做 TiO2 曲線，之後再做 SiO2 曲線。Slim 是在 TiO2 測試之後才完成的，因此只參與了 SiO2 這一輪。

blocks.en: The mass of particles added is the ground‑truth linear axis, and the BioDrop, the Pro and the Slim are each judged against it.

blocks.zh: 加入的顆粒質量是基準的線性軸，BioDrop、Pro 與 Slim 都以它為準來評斷。

blocks.en: We added known amounts of TiO2 to a 500 mL solution and used a BioDrop cuvette spectrophotometer as the reference instrument. We added 1 mg at a time up to 10 mg, then 5 mg at a time up to 60 mg. The small first steps give a denser low‑density region, in case the photometer was inaccurate at low values; the larger steps cover a wide range evenly.
blocks.text: We added known amounts of TiO2 to a 500 mL solution and used a BioDrop cuvette spectrophotometer as the reference instrument. We added 1 mg at a time up to 10 mg, then 5 mg at a time up to 60 mg. The small first steps give a denser low‑density region, in case the photometer was inaccurate at low values; the larger steps cover a wide range evenly.
blocks.zh: 我們把已知量的 TiO2 加進 500 mL 溶液，並以 BioDrop 比色槽式分光光度計作為參考儀器。先每次加 1 mg 加到 10 mg，之後每次加 5 mg 加到 60 mg。前面的小步幅讓低密度區的資料點更密，以防光度計在低值處不準；較大的步幅則平均地涵蓋較廣的範圍。

blocks.zh: 我們排除了一個資料點，並以空心標記表示。5 mg 的 BioDrop 讀值比它上下兩側的讀值都高，而這對一個遞增的標準品來說不可能發生。

blocks.en: We expected to need a calibration transform fitted against the BioDrop. On TiO2 the raw output was already close to one‑to‑one (median paired difference 3.8%, inside the 10% we set beforehand), so no transform was applied (notebook, entry 25b). The BioDrop was read undiluted in these runs, so the comparison can be trusted only up to about OD 1, even though the Pro appears to match across the whole range; in the SiO2 run the BioDrop’s samples above that were diluted (5.2.3).

blocks.en: The Slim was more linear (R² = 0.992) than the Pro (R² = 0.974). This supports the Slim as the TiO2 run supported the Pro. The difference likely comes from the Slim’s design, which puts the light much closer to the cuvette and sensors in a completely different structure.

blocks.en: At that short distance, light scattered by the particles can still reach the sensor. The 1 µm SiO2 particles are tiny next to the sensor’s 3.5 mm × 2 mm receptor, so light turned through small angles still lands on it. More light reaches the Slim’s sample sensor, so its measured OD600 is lower. That no longer matches the BioDrop, but it increases the range it can measure.

5.2.4 空白值作法

blocks.en: The blank caused much of the error in the early builds. The BioDrop is normally blanked on distilled water, but for bacteria we also need to account for the nutrient medium absorbing 600 nm light.

blocks.en: The baseline changed over time. V2 was zeroed on growth medium (3.3); the angled stand of cycle 4 was blanked on clear water, the BioDrop’s baseline (3.4); in the loop, a run starts with a blank on the growth medium (8.2). Since 19 July the photometer also accepts a blank typed in by hand, because the flow cuvette cannot be cleaned in the loop and a blank measured through a dirty window had read four times high (notebook, week 20).

blocks.en: The lens makes the LED’s light parallel, a 2 mm slit narrows it, and the splitter divides it 90:10. blocks.text: The lens makes the LED’s light parallel, a 2 mm slit narrows it, and the splitter divides it 90:10. The sample sensor sees the light after the culture; the reference sensor sees the LED alone. If the LED dims, both sensors see it, so OD600 is taken from their ratio and the drift cancels out.
blocks.zh: 透鏡讓 LED 的光變平行，2 mm 的狹縫把它收窄，分光鏡再以 90:10 分束。樣品感測器看到的是穿過培養液之後的光；參考感測器看到的只有 LED。LED 若變暗，兩顆感測器都會感受到，因此 OD600 是由兩者的比值求得，漂移也就相互抵消。
為什麼是 600 nm？三個理由

blocks.en: It is the standard. OD600 is how bacterial density is reported, so the readings compare directly with the BioDrop and with published growth curves.
blocks.text: It is the standard. OD600 is how bacterial density is reported, so the readings compare directly with the BioDrop and with published growth curves.
blocks.zh: 它是標準。細菌密度向來以 OD600 回報，因此這些讀值可以直接與 BioDrop、以及與已發表的生長曲線比較。

blocks.text: For each measurement the LED switches on and each sensor takes 16 lux readings in a short burst. The first 2 are dropped while the LED settles, leaving 14. A bubble passing during the burst may make one or two of them jump.

求中位數

blocks.en: The firmware uses the median, not the average. One or two extreme readings drag an average but barely move the median, so it resists bubbles.

blocks.zh: 在乾淨的流動中，用哪一種估計量幾乎無關。在這 40 個濃度上，八種估計量之間的差距從未超過 0.004 OD，比校正期間的散佈還小。

blocks.en: Under bubbles, one‑sided estimators fail. Five of the eight (MAD, Qn, biweight, mean and median) are symmetric, treating an unusually bright and an unusually dark reading alike. The other three (upper, p75 and p90) keep only the bright end of the burst. We had been running “upper”, assuming a bubble can only block light. In a turbid culture it does the opposite, because air replaces liquid full of particles, so more light reaches the detector. Under bubbles the five symmetric estimators stayed within 0.02 OD of each other on the Pro and 0.006 OD on the Slim, while the three one‑sided ones moved together, away from the rest. They did better on the Pro and worse on the Slim, so a bubble does not push both instruments the same way. We kept the symmetric MAD filter.

blocks.zh: 在有氣泡時，單側估計量會失效。八種當中有五種（MAD、Qn、biweight、平均值與中位數）是對稱的，對異常偏亮與異常偏暗的讀值一視同仁。另外三種（upper、p75 與 p90）只留下該組取樣偏亮的那一端。我們原本用的是「upper」，假設氣泡只會遮光。但在混濁的培養液中它的作用相反，因為空氣取代了充滿顆粒的液體，於是有更多光到達偵測器。在有氣泡時，五種對稱估計量在 Pro 上彼此相差不到 0.02 OD、在 Slim 上不到 0.006 OD，而三種單側估計量則一起偏離其餘估計量。它們在 Pro 上表現較好、在 Slim 上較差，可見氣泡並不會以同樣方式影響兩台儀器。我們保留了對稱的 MAD 濾波。

blocks.en: No estimator rescues a reading taken through air. A bubble can pass partway through a burst, spoiling a few of the 14 readings, or fill the cell for several seconds, so every reading in the burst is taken through air. Those readings agree perfectly and are all wrong. The MAD filter caught 94% of the first kind and none of the second. Once, the Pro reported 0.79 OD for 6 minutes while the true value was 3.18, and the software marked every reading good. So we added two gates that run after the estimator.

blocks.zh: 沒有任何估計量救得回一筆透過空氣量到的讀值。氣泡可能在一組取樣進行到一半時通過，毀掉 14 筆中的幾筆；也可能把比色槽填滿好幾秒，使整組取樣每一筆都是透過空氣量到的。那些讀值彼此完全一致，而且全都錯了。MAD 濾波抓到第一種的 94%，第二種則一個也沒抓到。有一次 Pro 連續 6 分鐘報出 0.79 OD，真值卻是 3.18，而軟體把每一筆讀值都標為正常。於是我們加了兩道在估計量之後執行的關卡。
關卡 1：該組取樣與自己比對

blocks.en: The same 14 readings are computed twice, with the MAD filter and with an upper‑percentile estimator. If the two differ by more than 0.03 OD, the reading is rejected. The upper estimator is not used for the OD itself. It agrees with MAD to a few thousandths of an OD in clean flow and pulls apart when a bubble passes. On the 10 October run this flagged 97% of disturbed readings and rejected none of the clean ones.

blocks.en: A reading more than 0.05 OD or 5% from the last accepted value is held back, and the new level is accepted only once 3 readings in a row agree with it. This catches air slugs. At the long run’s pace of about one reading every 10 minutes, 3 readings span 30 minutes, and a culture at 22 °C does not move 0.05 OD in that time. In run 6, at 37 °C on strain WB800, readings came about every 2.3 minutes (1083 in 41.8 h), so 3 span about 7 minutes; growing at 0.286 h<sup>−1</sup>, the culture moved about 1% per reading, under the 5% step. The cost is a few minutes’ delay and some lost points, and the gain is a growth curve that stays reliable over days and weeks.

blocks.en: Both final photometers use a soldered perfboard, not a breadboard, connected to an Arduino Uno Q. The Uno Q is a small computer itself, so it runs the code from a power supply alone, with no computer attached. That keeps the bioreactor cheaper and removes one failure point, a computer–Arduino cable coming unplugged.

The Uno Q is a small computer itself, so it runs the code from a power supply alone, with no computer attached. That keeps the bioreactor cheaper and removes one failure point, a computer–Arduino cable coming unplugged.
blocks.zh: 兩台最終版光度計都使用焊接的萬用板，而不是麵包板，並接到一片 Arduino Uno Q。Uno Q 本身就是一台小電腦，因此只要接上電源就能跑程式，不必接電腦。這讓生物反應器更便宜，也去掉一個失效點：電腦與 Arduino 之間的線被拔掉。

blocks.en: The Arduino has few ground ports, so the grounds of the sensors, LED and transistor are joined together.
blocks.text: The Arduino has few ground ports, so the grounds of the sensors, LED and transistor are joined together.
blocks.zh: Arduino 的接地孔位不多，因此感測器、LED 與電晶體的接地接在一起。

blocks.en: The transistor lets the LED run at a different voltage from the sensors and switch on and off without affecting the sensors. As the bioreactor scales up, the LED may need more voltage, and it is safer and longer‑lasting if the LED is not on all the time.

blocks.zh: 電晶體讓 LED 能用與感測器不同的電壓運作，也能開關而不影響感測器。生物反應器放大之後，LED 可能需要更高的電壓；而 LED 不是一直亮著，也更安全、壽命更長。

blocks.en: The LED’s ground wire goes to the transistor’s collector. Arduino pin D3 drives the base through a 1.2 kΩ resistor, a 10 kΩ resistor joins the base to the emitter, and the emitter joins the sensor grounds at one Arduino ground port.

blocks.zh: LED 的接地線接到電晶體的集極。Arduino 的 D3 腳位透過一顆 1.2 kΩ 電阻驅動基極，一顆 10 kΩ 電阻把基極接到射極，射極則與感測器接地一起接到 Arduino 的同一個接地孔位。

blocks.en: The photometer lets a student or researcher follow the OD600 of a culture through a growth run. It removes the need to sample, and the human error that comes with it. The parts cost US$371.78 for the Pro and US$235.29 for the Slim (11.1), which drops the US$100 paralleling lens and the US$40 beam splitter. The BioDrop we calibrated against costs NT$15 000, about US$470, so the Slim comes to roughly half that price and the Pro a little below it. The larger gain is not the saving. A benchtop instrument cannot sit in the loop and read without a sample being drawn. With a 3D printer and these parts, anyone who needs in‑line OD600 can build one, and we hope others adapt the design to their own experiments.

blocks.en: Safe use. In the loop, the flow cell contains live Bacillus subtilis culture. blocks.zh: 安全使用。在迴路中，流通池裡裝的是活的 Bacillus subtilis 培養液。處理它，以及任何從它滴出來的東西時，都要比照生物反應器的培養液，依其圍阻規定（生物反應器，第 8 部分）與迴路的原位清洗滅菌程序（生物反應器，整合原型 3）辦理。流通比色槽在迴路中無法清洗（5.2.4）。電子部分以 5 V 與 3.3 V 運作（9.1）。
